title: Lav Kush
desc: After Ram returns to Ayodhya, Sita is exiled and raises twins Lav and Kush in the forest. Years later, they journey to Ayodhya to meet Ram and narrate the Ramayan.

title: Vijaypath
desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

title: Daraar
desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy businessman, falls for Priya Bhatia, a charming real estate agent. But when he proposes, his world shatters-Priya is already married.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

title: 2.0 Robot
desc: When mobile phones mysteriously fly from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and Nila investigate. To stop Pakshi Rajan's chaos, they must revive Chitti for a decisive battle.

title: AB Tumhare Hawale Watan Saathiyo
desc: Kunal reluctantly joins the army to uphold his family's legacy but soon faces ruthless terrorists threatening Indo-Pak peace, pushing him to rise and protect his nation.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: After losing custody of his daughter to Maya, Abhay dies in an accident. Soon, his restless spirit returns, haunting their peaceful lives and unsettling their newfound happiness.

title: Great Grand Masti
desc: Three friends meet Ragini in a small town. Her beauty charms them, but soon they realise she brings danger, mystery, and trouble into their lives.

title: Naseeb
desc: Namdev, Raghu, Damu, and Jaggi win a lottery. Greed consumes Raghu and Damu, who murder Jaggi and frame Namdev. Returning later, Namdev seeks revenge against his betrayers.

title: Samadhi
desc: Lakhan Singh leaves crime for love and marries Champa. When she falls ill, he's forced to return to his old ways to save her.

title: Ek Rishtaa: The Bond of Love
desc: Ajay's relationship with his powerful businessman father is strained, but when he discovers his brother-in-law's malicious plans, he rises to protect his family.

title: Little John
desc: John seeks a guru's help to impress his girlfriend's parents but ends up shrinking instead of turning invisible. To reverse it, he must find a powerful magic ring.

title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Koi Mil Gaya
desc: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

title: Saheb Biwi Aur Gangster 3
desc: After returning from jail, Aditya seeks to reclaim his political legacy, but his encounter with London based gangster Uday sparks a fierce battle for power and survival.

title: Bamfaad
desc: Nasir, a reckless politician's son, falls for Neelam, a rival's mistress. Their affair sparks a violent feud that spirals into bloodshed and political chaos.
